_meta.description: API knowledge store – one object per API with simplified metadata

apis.name: Store Location API
apis.description: Get store/outlet locations, opening hours, and availability by geography or filters.

apis.name: Bank Check Balance API
apis.description: Verify bank account and check balance for payment flows (top-up, bill pay).

apis.name: SIM Swap API
apis.description: Initiate and query SIM swap requests; check swap eligibility and status.

apis.name: Customer Status API
apis.description: Customer profile summary, account status, segment, and service eligibility.

apis.name: Top-Up / Recharge API
apis.description: Prepaid airtime and data top-up, bundle purchase, and recharge history.

apis.name: Bill Pay API
apis.description: Pay postpaid bills, schedule payments, and retrieve payment status.

apis.name: Usage / Consumption API
apis.description: Data, voice, and SMS usage and consumption for prepaid and postpaid.

apis.name: Device Swap API
apis.description: Register device change and swap device binding for a subscriber.

apis.name: Number Portability (MNP) API
apis.description: Check portability status and initiate number port-in/port-out requests.

apis.name: OTP / Verification API
apis.description: Send and verify OTP for login, transactions, and step-up authentication.

apis.name: Subscriber Registration API
apis.description: Register new prepaid/postpaid subscribers and validate identity.

apis.name: Balance Inquiry API
apis.description: Prepaid balance and postpaid account balance and credit limit.

apis.name: Bundle Purchase API
apis.description: Purchase data, voice, and SMS bundles; list available bundles and active bundles.

apis.name: Roaming Status API
apis.description: Check roaming status, activate roaming packs, and get roaming usage.

apis.name: Coverage Check API
apis.description: Check network coverage and quality by location (lat/long or address).

apis.name: Complaints / Tickets API
apis.description: Create and track customer complaints and support tickets.

apis.name: Payment History API
apis.description: Retrieve payment and transaction history for a subscriber or account.

apis.name: Invoice Download API
apis.description: Generate and download postpaid invoices (PDF) and list invoice summaries.

apis.name: Plan Change / Migration API
apis.description: Change tariff plan, migrate prepaid to postpaid, and check eligibility.

apis.name: Loyalty / Rewards API
apis.description: Loyalty points balance, earn/burn, and rewards catalog and redemption.

apis.name: Agent Commission API
apis.description: Agent commission balance, transactions, and payout history.

apis.name: KYC / Identity Verification API
apis.description: Submit and verify KYC documents and identity for regulatory compliance.

apis.name: Blacklist / Fraud API
apis.description: Check and manage blacklist; report and query fraud indicators.

apis.name: Notification Preferences API
apis.description: Get and update notification preferences (SMS, email, push) per channel.

apis.name: Product Catalog API
apis.description: Product and offer catalog for devices, plans, and add-ons.

apis.name: Order Status API
apis.description: Track order status for devices, SIMs, and home delivery.

apis.name: Activation / Provisioning API
apis.description: Activate new lines, provision services, and sync with network.

apis.name: Partner Onboarding API
apis.description: Onboard partners, manage credentials, and approve API access.

apis.name: Audit Log / Activity API
apis.description: Retrieve audit log and user activity for compliance and security.

apis.name: Speed Test / Network Quality API
apis.description: Trigger and retrieve speed test results and network quality metrics.

apis.name: Spending Summary API
apis.description: User-facing total spend for a period: prepaid top-ups, postpaid bill, add-ons, and roaming in one summary.

apis.name: Transaction Breakdown API
apis.description: Itemized list of transactions (top-ups, bundle buys, pay-as-you-go) with amount and date for money usage view.

apis.name: Bill Breakdown / Itemized Bill API
apis.description: Itemized postpaid bill: plan fee, usage charges, add-ons, discounts, and total for user money breakdown.

apis.name: Usage Cost API
apis.description: Data, voice, and SMS usage converted to cost (pay-as-you-go or overage) for user money usage display.

apis.name: Monthly Spend API
apis.description: Total amount spent per calendar month for charts and trends in money usage app.

apis.name: Budget Alerts API
apis.description: Get and set spending limits and budget alerts; notify user when threshold is reached.

apis.name: Spend by Category API
apis.description: Spending grouped by category: plan, data, voice, SMS, roaming, add-ons for money usage breakdown.

apis.name: Recharge / Spend History API
apis.description: Chronological list of recharges and spend (top-up, bundle, payg) for user money history.

output.items: array of { date, type, amount } objects

apis.name: Roaming Spend API
apis.description: Spend and usage while roaming: data, voice, SMS cost by country or trip for money usage app.

apis.name: Wallet Balance & Spend API
apis.description: Prepaid wallet balance and recent spend from wallet for in-app balance and money usage.
